attack_surface.boundary: the local machine: what is written to and read from disk, and what is accepted from the index and refs

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: self-signed forgeries pass (TM-R01); other clients ignore it (A8); a vault that switched it on before 0.21 has no recorded start
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: pull and clone refuse unsigned, bad or no-key commits made since the policy was switched on (signed-since-<head>)

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: features and min_client follow the server's copy on merge, so a host replaying an older index can drop them (TM-R29); a fresh clone takes whatever the host serves
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: a clone never lowers the format number it has seen

proposed.fix: compare with type(parsed[k]) is type(v) as well

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: readable() accepts `deleted: 1` for `deleted: true` (True == 1 in the round-trip compare), so an entry another client wrote that way is not carried but coerced
The two known regression pairs hold: TM-F25->F29 (carried entries round-trip exactly) and TM-F27->F30 (every None from read_regular keeps the committed entry)
A name whose entry has an unreadable timestamp is hidden on 0.21 clients (unjudged entry wins)
